nom: 1.8% Salicylic Acid Acne Spot Treatment Drying Lotion

avis.texte: Works great , have to be consistent but its totally worth it . Does dry out the spots you use it on but a good moisturizer would be recommended!

I really love this 1.8% Salicylic Acid Acne Spot Treatment! It’s easy to apply and works great when I have a breakout. I noticed my pimples looked smaller and less noticeable after using it, especially overnight. A little goes a long way, and it’s perfect for targeting individual blemishes.

This spot treatment is easy to apply and works well as part of my skincare routine. I like using it directly on blemishes, and it dries down quickly without feeling overly heavy or sticky. The salicylic acid formula helps keep problem areas feeling clean, and a small amount is all you need. Convenient to have on hand whenever a breakout pops up.

This stuff actually works! I had 3 enormous pimples on my face (the bloody pus filled ones) and this brought it down a lot in one night. I’ve applied it 3x on and off and my pimples are flat. The only reason I gave it 4 stars was because of the smell. It’s really potent, the first time I tried it, I tasted it. It’s worth the money. Super easy to use.

Used on my teenage soon who is struggling with Acne. Already noticed a difference after 1 use. His acne was noticeable smaller and dry. The redness was almost gone. He said he didn't feel any itching or burning which was great.

I really like how this product is applied. It has a thicker formula that settles at the bottom and should not be shaken. I apply it directly to each pimple or mark before going to bed and leave it on overnight. It's very convenient to add to my nighttime routine and use only where I need it.
Is majorly helping get rid of post acne pigmentation!/ reducing the look. Doesn’t prevent acne. Easy to use and worth it!

Only works sometimes. It dies fast, but flakes off really easily and does not last the night when it’s supposed to. I haven’t noticed much of a difference in scars, but it has reduced swelling. Does not clear the acne completely, only reduces it.
I loved this product! It leaves my skin soft after application, it's not sticky, and you can see the effects from the first use. It's great for oily skin.
I highly recommend this product, it's super good for all those people who have acne, the truth is that it's very good, I can't miss it
Very good product Only one weeks used can already see the result don’t shaking 🫨 working good

avis.titre: Fast-Acting Acne Spot Treatment That Really Works
avis.texte: This spot treatment helps reduce the size and redness of pimples overnight without being too harsh on my skin. The formula dries quickly, and the niacinamide leaves my skin looking calmer with continued use. A great addition to my skincare routine for unexpected breakouts.

Here I am excited about this product that pulled the hair out of its follicle. I have very sensitive skin and it wasn’t irritated after application. It was very easy to use and worth way more than the suggested price. It’s not greasy and comes with an applicator
I took the shot in buying it when there is alot of products on the market and it works! GET IT!

avis.titre: Product works but dries a white color.
avis.texte: I ordered this product for my 2 teenage children who are currently struggling with acne. The product contains a decent dose of salicylic acid and sulfur, which are both known to be acne fighters . It also contains niacinamide, which reduces inflammation and reduces pore size, and zinc oxide, which is antibacterial, soothes inflammation, and promotes healing. All of these work together in this product to help fight pimples. I wish the directions were on the box, but I had to look online for them. The important thing to remember is to not shake the bottle. I instinctively shook it bc the product was clearly separated into 2 layers, so I had to wait a few minutes for it to settle again. After the face is washed and dried, you can dip the enclosed individually wrapped cotton swabs (or just qtips when the enclosed ones run out) into the bottle but to the bottom white layer. Then dab it just on the targeted pimples. The liquid dries white so I would only use it at night as it can’t be hidden under makeup. The directions say to leave it on for at least an hour, but it can be left on all night. It does effectively dry out the pimples. However, I took a star off because I don’t find it convenient to use. My kids normally use pimple patches which seem to do the same thing and they also wear them at night. If this product could be used/worn during the day, it would definitely have an advantage over other products that target pimples. The bottle is a fair price since it is a descent size

I had high hopes for this, but it didn’t really deliver. The powder took an unusually long time to separate from the liquid, which made it frustrating to use since you’re not supposed to shake it. Even once I managed to apply it, the results were underwhelming. My pimples didn’t shrink much, and redness stuck around longer than expected. It also felt a bit drying without actually clearing anything up. I did not notice any skin irritation which is a plus! Overall, it might work for others, but for me it was slow, inconvenient, and not very effective. The scent however was pleasant.

Don’t shake it…even though I did! Instructions on the package are different from instructions listed in the online description. Online says “do not shake,” but I can’t find that on the package. The liquid looks odd separated in the bottle, and I instinctively shook it. :( After letting the product re-settle…the Acne Buster solution was effective in reducing a bump on my face. I noticed a significant difference after 2 uses. You apply the liquid by dipping a cotton swab into the bottle and dabbing the swab on your skin. (10 individually packaged cotton swabs are included.) It dries opaque and flaky, so you can’t hide it under makeup. I used it at night, and my skin was a bit dry the next day but not irritated. Try to only apply precisely on the spots you want to treat, to avoid drying out a large area. I didn’t notice any scent after it dried. The bottle is small, but a tiny amount goes a long way. I probably won’t use this again for average bumps because getting the product out of the bottle and applying it is a bit messy. However, I would use this for a large or infected bump that requires extra effort to heal.

this really works ! you go through it fast ..well that's because i put it all over because i have old acne dark marks but its only been 8 days and i see a huge difference cant wait until its fully gone.

avis.titre: It works , be consistent with it
avis.texte: I love it , I use every night before going to sleep so you can use overnight. Helps with black heads and don’t shake the bottle. Use the cotton swabs it’s helps a lot .

This salicylic acid spot serum is something that I wouldn’t call a serum- It’s more of a treatment paste for acne. It reminds me a lot of a Principal Secret version of this that my mother orders, though this one is less expensive I believe. This is drying if you used it all over your face, but if you just use it as a spot treatment, it is very effective at pulling the unwanted juicy stuff out of acne. The treatment has somewhat clay like scent to it. It also looks a bit like a clay mask went on. It goes on white so you definitely want to use this at night time. I did not find this irritating for my skin and the application was easy. You just shake the bottle and dab it on with the provided Q-tips.

This is the product I reach for when I feel a painful pimple coming in. I apply it at night and by morning the redness is reduced and the spot is noticeably calmer. It’s the perfect size for what you get and is a great value. There is no scent. It works fast without completely drying out my skin or causing flaking around the area. I've used harsher spot treatments that leave marks — this one doesn't. It's not something I use daily, but when I need it, it absolutely does its job.

avis.titre: Great for getting rid of the red!
avis.texte: This stuff is great -- if you use it right. Basically, I find it an effective tool to use at night. During the day, it's too white and flakey to use under makeup, as it sloughs the foundation off. Using it at night, however, works really well at reducing the redness and drying out any bumps you have. It didn't cause any skin irritation, but I was definitely careful in how I put it on. It only dries out what it touches, so you don't have to worry about it messing with your moisturizer. Since you use so little -- provided you don't have significant acne -- it will last a long time despite being a small size. It is $22.99 (at time of review), and I expect it will last for several months, making it a good value for the money. Mix it slowly (no shaking). It is thick but mixable. Finally, it has a slightly medicinal scent, but it's barely noticeable.

avis.titre: Gentle Spot Treatment That Works Quickly
avis.texte: I've been using this acne drying lotion as a spot treatment, and it’s been a solid addition to my skincare routine. The formula combines salicylic acid with niacinamide, which helps calm redness while targeting breakouts — a nice balance compared to harsher treatments. It’s easy to use: just dip a cotton swab into the bottle and dab directly onto blemishes. I like applying it at night, and by morning I usually notice that pimples look flatter and less inflamed. It dries quickly and doesn’t leave a heavy or greasy residue. I also appreciate that the kit includes cotton swabs, which makes application simple and more hygienic. The bottle is small but a little goes a long way since you only need a tiny amount per spot. Cons: It can be slightly drying if you use it too frequently, so a good moisturizer helps to keep your skin soft, and the bottle size is on the smaller side. Overall, this is an effective, straightforward spot treatment for occasional breakouts, especially if you want something that works overnight without being overly harsh.

Dr. Leo 1.8% Salicylic Acid Drying Lotion – 0.34 fl oz This drying lotion works exactly as intended. The 1.8% salicylic acid formula is effective at calming active breakouts and noticeably reducing redness overnight. It targets blemishes without overly irritating the surrounding skin, which is especially important if you have sensitive skin. I like that it dries quickly and stays put once applied. A small amount goes a long way, and the compact size makes it easy to keep in a travel kit or gym bag. It’s strong enough to make a difference but still gentle enough for spot treatment use. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5 Stars Very solid acne treatment—highly recommend.

avis.titre: Works well, even on my super sensitive skin.
avis.texte: This 1.8% salicylic acid/4% miacinamide solution is fantastic,even on my sensitive skin! I can't apply in large areas so I just do small spots and it clears up fast! Does have a smell amd do not shake! Decent price and quality ingredients that work!
I saw improvement after two treatments. The spot treatment is very visible, be aware when and where you're applying it.

avis.titre: Around $58 per ounce. Fussy to apply.
avis.texte: I don't get it. Why do you have to mess with keeping ingredients separated rather than just making a product that comes in two separate bottles? Let's break this down. Does it moisturize? Uhhh, no. If anything, it dries it out, hence "drying lotion". Does it get rid of dark spots? No, not in my experience. Does it help clear up acne? Somewhat. Does it irritate my skin? No. I can't say it did much other than sort of drying out acne, but I can't say it really did a lot for hardcore acne. Does it smell? Meh, not much. Nothing noticeable to me. Is it worth the money? No. I get better results from a cream that costs half of what this does, and I don't have to mess with separated ingredients and swabs. Is it a large bottle? No. And at around $58 PER OUNCE (at the time of ordering), it is only slightly less than pure silver. Conclusion: the price is insane, especially when you consider it does nothing for dark spots, and very little for acne. Then, when you consider all the fru-fru fuss required to apply it, they should pay me to use this. I would not reorder. It may work for some, but it's a pointless mess for me.

I have a small problem that I don't get a lot of acne. This seems like a good product, but in the months since I got it, I have had nothing to test it on. I tried it on my nose tonight to at least make sure it does no harm. Check! It's got a mild tingling and it does seem to be a bit drying - so I expect it does have salicylic acid and would probably offer some ability to treat acne. Note - it is a white liquid and it dries on white. And stays white, even for an hour or more after. I'm not clear on how long one should leave it on - but it's probably best for a nighttime treatment. There's no scent, it was really easy to use (just dab on w a Q-tip) and I suspect you can get a LOT of uses out of it.

avis.titre: Quick acting zit treatment- be sure to let the liquid and white stuff stay separated!
avis.texte: I received Dr. Leo 1.8% Salicylic Acid Drying Lotion – Face Acne Treatment, Reduces Blemishes and Pimples, Soothes Spots and Acne, Suitable for Sensitive Skin, 0.34 fl oz (20 ml) when it was priced at $22.99 which is a decent value since a little goes a long way. The instructions online emphasize the importance of not shaking and instead allowing the clear liquid to separate from the white part, and then dipping the cotton swab into the white stuff to dab on the pimple. I'm docking one star because the instructions that come with the treatment do not mention this, so I think most people will think it needs to be shaken up. My husband dabbed some on a zit that was forming beneath the skin and let it do its thing overnight, and the next morning the zit had formed into a white head that he was able to easily pop. He saw this as a success, as the zit then chilled out and went away. He didn't feel the need to put any more medication on it afterwards, so this is the only use we've had with it so far. So it seems like a quick acting zit treatment, but should be used when you're not planning on being seen since it does leave an opaque white residue. So it's best for a night treatment.

avis.titre: Very effective but be aware it goes on and dries very white
avis.texte: This isn't really what I was looking for, but that doesn't make it a bad product. It goes on very white and does not dry clear, so it's not something you can use under makeup, or something most would feel comfortable going out in public with it applied. It also has a sulpher smell to it, which sometimes bothers me and sometimes doesn't. Last night I had to wash my face shortly after applying it as there was no way I could handle the smell all night, and I only had it applied to a blemish on my chin. Be sure to read the instructions and not shake the bottle. You're supposed to dip the cotton swab into the powder in the bottom of the bottle and apply that to your blemish(es). It is very effective in drying acne, and something I wish I'd had as a teenager. I like that it comes with a few cotton swabs, but I used my own and will save the nicely sealed ones for travel.

I have been dealing with some breakouts lately and have been using this as a spot treatment. The application is very easy. You simply dip a cotton swab straight down into the unmixed formula before applying it to the skin. It does have a strong scent but it quickly fades. Overall, it feels fairly gentle. I only experienced a slight sting on one blemish where the skin was already broken. While I did not see improvements overnight, I did see a visible reduction after using it two nights in a row. My largest breakout looked and felt noticeably smaller. Because it dries down to a chalky white spot, it is definitely a product to use only at night. It is also a bit drying and does not provide any moisture, so keep that in mind if your skin is on the dry side. The bottle is small, but since you only need a tiny amount each time, it should last quite a while, making it a decent value overall.

avis.titre: Simple, Effective Spot Treatment That Does What It Says
avis.texte: I get the occasional small zit right around the time of the month, and this Dr. Leo 1.8% salicylic acid drying lotion has been great for those spots. It’s not miracle magic and it doesn’t claim to be but it does exactly what it’s supposed to. I apply a tiny amount directly to the blemish before bed, and overnight it helps calm the redness and size. After a few days it’s almost gone, which is exactly the kind of predictable result I’m looking for from a spot treatment. This works differently from pimple patches. Pimple patches physically cover a spot with a soft, adhesive hydrocolloid that absorbs fluid and protects the area from picking and external irritants. They’re great if you want a protective barrier and quick flattening of a blemish. This salicylic acid lotion, on the other hand, chemically exfoliates. The salicylic acid works to unclog pores and dissolve the buildup inside a blemish, so you’re treating it from the inside out rather than covering it from the outside. Both have their uses, but I like having this lotion on hand for occasional breakouts because it feels more like a traditional acne treatment and doesn’t leave anything asvisible on the skin like a patch does. I have sensitive skin and didn’t experience irritation or burning when I used this as directed. It dries down quickly and doesn’t feel greasy or heavy, so I can put it on at night and not worry about it transferring to my pillow.
